season.short_description: Season of the cumulative count, written as 2024-25.
season.long_description: Season the cumulative count belongs to. Flu and adult RSV vaccine counts start July 1 and infant RSV antibody counts start April 1.

vaccine.short_description: Flu (influenza vaccine), rsv (RSV vaccine, adults 75+), or rsv_mab (RSV monoclonal antibody, infants under 8 months).
vaccine.long_description: Immunization the count refers to. For flu, at least one dose of seasonal influenza vaccine (children and adults by age group, 2022-23 season onward). For rsv, at least one dose of RSV vaccine among adults 75 years and older (2024-25 onward). For rsv_mab, at least one dose of an RSV monoclonal antibody (nirsevimab, and from 2025-26 clesrovimab) among infants under 8 months.

age.short_description: Age group of the count, using CDC's labels.
age.long_description: Age group as labelled by CDC. Flu counts are reported for children and adults by age group, RSV vaccine for adults 75 and older, and RSV antibody for infants 0-7 months.

jurisdiction.long_name: Immunization information system jurisdiction as named by CDC
jurisdiction.short_description: Name of the reporting jurisdiction as published by CDC.
jurisdiction.long_description: Name of the reporting jurisdiction as published by CDC. New York and Pennsylvania exclude New York City and Philadelphia, which report separately.

partial_state_flag.long_name: State row excludes a separately reporting city
partial_state_flag.short_description: 1 if the state row excludes a city that reports separately, 0 otherwise.
partial_state_flag.long_description: 1 for New York excluding New York City and Pennsylvania excluding Philadelphia County, 0 otherwise. Counts and populations for these rows cover only the rest of the state.

geography_name.long_name: CDC name of the non-FIPS jurisdiction
geography_name.short_description: Name of the city or freely associated state.
geography_name.long_description: Name of the jurisdiction in data_substate.csv.gz. The geography column in that file is not a FIPS code.

geography_level.short_description: Type of jurisdiction: City or Freely associated state.
geography_level.long_description: Type of jurisdiction in data_substate.csv.gz: City or Freely associated state.

state_fips.long_name: FIPS code of the state containing the city
state_fips.short_description: FIPS code of the state that contains the city.
state_fips.long_description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state that contains the city. Missing for freely associated states.

iis_n_vaccinated.long_name: Cumulative number of people with at least one dose recorded
iis_n_vaccinated.short_description: Number of residents with at least one dose recorded, cumulative from the start of the season.
iis_n_vaccinated.long_description: Cumulative number of residents in the age group with at least one dose recorded in the jurisdiction's immunization information system, from the start of the season through the end of the month. Counts include invalid doses and people who died after vaccination.
iis_n_vaccinated.statement: In {location}, {value} people had at least one dose recorded by {time}

iis_population.long_name: Population denominator for the age group
iis_population.short_description: Population of the age group used as the coverage denominator.
iis_population.long_description: Census population estimate of the age group in the jurisdiction, used by CDC as the coverage denominator.

iis_coverage.long_name: Cumulative percent of the population with at least one dose recorded
iis_coverage.short_description: Percent of the age group with at least one dose recorded, cumulative through the month.
iis_coverage.long_description: Number of residents with at least one dose recorded divided by the population of the age group. Completeness varies by jurisdiction, and not every jurisdiction reports, so CDC publishes no national estimate. No confidence intervals are published because registries aim to record every dose.
iis_coverage.statement: In {location}, {value}% had at least one dose recorded by {time}

iis.name: Immunization Information Systems (IIS) monthly submissions to CDC
iis.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
iis.location: Monthly Cumulative Number and Percent of Persons Who Received Influenza and RSV Immunizations by Jurisdiction (FluVaxView and RSVVaxView dashboards)
iis.description: Immunization Information Systems (IIS) are the confidential, population-based registries that states, some large cities, and territories use to record vaccine doses given by participating providers. Jurisdictions submit counts to CDC each month, by age group, of residents with at least one dose of flu vaccine, RSV vaccine among adults 75 and older, or RSV monoclonal antibody among infants under 8 months. Counts are cumulative from the start of the season and are divided by the previous year's Census population estimate to give coverage. Completeness varies with each jurisdiction's reporting laws and provider participation, so IIS coverage usually runs below survey estimates. Fifty-four jurisdictions reported through the 2024-25 season and about half as many in 2025-26, and CDC publishes no national estimate.
iis.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.name: IIS monthly flu and RSV immunization by jurisdiction
_catalog.summary: State immunization registries report to CDC each month how many residents have received a flu vaccine, an RSV vaccine, or an infant RSV antibody, by age group.

files.data.csv.gz: Monthly cumulative immunization counts and coverage by immunization and age group
files.data_substate.csv.gz: Monthly counts for cities and freely associated states (non-FIPS)
